design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER task 1. Step 0 draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 5, 5]} -> loan_ext_closing_disclosure_lender_credit 6, loan_ext_revised_le_zero_tolerance 6, loan_ext_application_fee_due 5, loan_ext_zero_tolerance_cure 5.

ROUND 2 REVISION LOG. (F-1) The cure rule now defines the measured increase explicitly as the latest minus the initial Loan Estimate zero-tolerance total kept with its sign, the baseline sentence floors only that signed figure, every adjustment applies to the signed figure and the final result alone is floored; compute_basis quotes the definition sentence. (O-5) The cure also cites loan_changed_circumstance and declares in overwrite that the initial Loan Estimate stays the baseline disclosure while changed-circumstance increases are taken out of the measured increase. (F-3, charter class) Both prerequisite sentences on the fee now read '... wherever the program the file is in charges an application fee', the conditions accept a program application_fee of 0.00, and the fee rule books a 0.00 collection when a charging program's discounts bring the amount due to zero — so a VA, HomeReady or fully-discounted file can always reach the state its revised Loan Estimate and Closing Disclosure wait on. (F-4b,c) With that, the 'no collection on the ledger' fall-through of collected_fee_line and collected_fee_addback is live (a program that charges no application fee). (CD tier sweep) open_cure_credit's middle tier now selects open post-closing-refund cures moved onto the Closing Disclosure instead of a balance that could only disagree with the cure entries. (TRID, coordinator) Real TRID bars giving a Closing Disclosure on the day a revised Loan Estimate is given: the Closing Disclosure rule now dates it on the next business day when a Loan Estimate was issued the same day, and the Closing Disclosure tool takes that date; here it is Friday 2026-10-16. (Chain RED) prerequisite_closure's skip and wrong-order figures were recomputed with the charter compute; the false 'cure 0.00' claims are gone. Scored values unchanged: 105.10 / 2703.00 / 150.00 / 2525.10; new argument issued_date 2026-10-16.

WHY A GOOD TEST: the borrower asks only for his Closing Disclosure. Its lender credits wait on two record states that do not hold: no application fee has been collected (his program charges 450.00; he pays it himself, priced by five factors over his pre-approval, Heroes credit, e-sign history, prior Larkspur closing and credit report ledger), and no cure covers the zero-tolerance increases. The cure waits on the latest Loan Estimate carrying the 2026-10-13 lock-extension circumstance, and that revised Loan Estimate's total waits on the fee actually collected. Four problems, each priced on the world the previous one leaves, one handed to the borrower; one tool per problem.

SCOPE: task 0 = credit report repull + corrected Closing Disclosure. Task 1 = loan_ext_application_fee_due (pay_application_fee_6c3f9eab, user), loan_ext_revised_le_zero_tolerance (issue_revised_loan_estimate_22df4f86), loan_ext_zero_tolerance_cure (assess_tolerance_cure_d5e015cb), loan_ext_closing_disclosure_lender_credit (issue_closing_disclosure_6debf4ff). Disjoint; together all six policies.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root loan_ext_closing_disclosure_lender_credit. Edges, all value_input and state form: (1) CD -> fee, gate fee_credit, 'The lender credits on a Closing Disclosure are fixed only after the fee ledger carries the application fee collected on the file, wherever the program the file is in charges an application fee.' (affirmative); (2) CD -> cure, gate cure_credit, 'The lender credits on a Closing Disclosure are not fixed until every zero-tolerance increase over the good-faith baseline has a cure entry assessed on the file.' (negated); (3) cure -> revised LE, gate latest_estimate_total, 'A zero-tolerance cure is assessed only after the latest Loan Estimate on the file carries the changed circumstance documented most recently on the file.' (affirmative); (4) revised LE -> fee, gate fee_collected_line, 'The zero-tolerance total on a revised Loan Estimate is not fixed until the fee ledger shows the application fee actually collected on the file, wherever the program the file is in charges an application fee.' (negated). Each has an ordering connective, a record-visible state (fee-ledger collection; cure entries; the latest Loan Estimate's documented circumstance), no tool/id/code token, and the strength of its condition; the fee sentences now name their scope (programs that charge a fee). One writer per state: only the fee payment books application fee collections, only the cure tool books cures, only the revised Loan Estimate tool books Loan Estimates. Opening evidence: no collection (program fee 450.00); no cure row although the 150.00 gross living area surcharge of 2026-08-13 was never redisclosed; latest Loan Estimate is revision 2 (circumstance 2026-08-21) while the newest lock request is 2026-10-13. Order fee (12) -> revised LE (19) -> cure (21) -> CD (23), fully pinned. Load-bearing runs (charter compute): skip fee -> revised LE 3047.90, CD 2420.00; skip revised LE -> cure 476.90; skip cure -> CD 2375.10; wrong order revised LE before fee -> 3047.90 and cure 494.90.

FACTOR CARD loan_ext_application_fee_due (baseline 450.00): pre-approval rate 0.75 (Verified) -> 217.60 if missed; Heroes discount 50.00 (multi-source status x occupation, nurse) -> 155.10; e-disclosure 40.00 (multi-source: intent by e-sign and no paper Loan Estimate) -> 145.10; returning 50.00 (cross funding history: most recent funding wire 2019-06-12; near-miss: the scheduled 2026 closing has no wire) -> 155.10; credit report offset (method) booked 92.40 -> 197.50. Result 105.10, above zero so the collection is a normal payment.

FACTOR CARD loan_ext_revised_le_zero_tolerance (baseline fee sheet 2879.90): lock extension line +368.00 (cross lock; near-miss: 5 of 10 days complimentary) -> 2335.00 if missed; surcharge line +150.00 -> 2553.00; rush line +150.00 -> 2553.00; underwriting relief -300.00 -> 3003.00; processing relief -200.00 -> 2903.00; collected fee line (method) 105.10 replaces 450.00 -> 3047.90. Result 2703.00.

FACTOR CARD loan_ext_zero_tolerance_cure (baseline: the signed measured increase -176.90 floored at zero = 0.00): extension re-baselining -368.00 -> 518.00 if missed; rush re-baselining -150.00 -> 300.00; underwriting add-back +300.00, processing add-back +200.00, fee add-back +344.90 (each missed -> 0.00). Result -176.90 - 368.00 - 150.00 + 300.00 + 200.00 + 344.90 = 150.00, the unredisclosed surcharge.

FACTOR CARD loan_ext_closing_disclosure_lender_credit (baseline: fee credit 105.10 + initial Loan Estimate credit 368.00 = 473.10): lock pricing credit 920.00 replaces 368.00 -> 1973.10 if missed; open cure credit 150.00 -> 2375.10; Hybrid eClosing credit 150.00 -> 2375.10; returning credit 100.00 -> 2425.10; short-notice credit 100.00 (closing 7 days after the day the Closing Disclosure is prepared) -> 2425.10; standing credit balance 1000.00 from the credit ledger -> 1525.10. Result 2525.10.

LADDER LIVENESS (class sweep): every tier of the four ladders can hold at its own write once the prerequisites hold — the fee-related fall-throughs hold for programs that charge no application fee, the refunded-in-full tiers for improper or denial refunds, the open-cure middle tier for post-closing-refund cures, the rush schedule tier when rush was asked but not yet charged; no two tiers of one ladder select the same value or method.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD: fee - loan_evt_application_fee after_intent_to_proceed (status clear_to_close) and once_per_file (no collection); overwrite replaces only the amount sentence. Revised LE - loan_changed_circumstance coc_redisclosed_in_time (documented 2026-10-13, 3 business days inclusive -> through 2026-10-16; issued 2026-10-15) and revised_le_before_cd (no Closing Disclosure yet); receipt 4 specific business days before 2026-10-22 (by 2026-10-17) feasible by e-sign. Cure - loan_tolerance_cure (gate only for post-closing payment) with the declared overwrites. Closing Disclosure - dated 2026-10-16, the business day after the revised Loan Estimate, never the same day; received 2026-10-16 it leaves 3 specific business days before 2026-10-22; the 2026-08-04 Loan Estimate satisfies the seven-day wait.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: open loan file 29f8e3a8-50b5-40d4-ae0f-da3888b8c9ad (3756 Linworth Meadow Lane); the 2019 consummated file only evidences the returning tiers through its funded closing; one lock with one extension, one appraisal order (base, rush, gla charges), converted Verified pre-approval, verified Heroes credit, scheduled Hybrid eClosing. The cure names the initial Loan Estimate and the revised Loan Estimate returned by step 19 (lle_909f70c7d407).

PERSONA: wry ER nurse on a break; volunteers the moved closing and the missing Closing Disclosure; phone then SSN4; gives the request date when asked; pays anything handed to him by Visa debit card after hearing the amount; accepts mention of other paperwork; closes when told the Closing Disclosure is prepared for his portal (today or the next business day). Never names a fee, cure or Loan Estimate.

STANDARD SOLUTION: locate/verify; read files, fee ledger, disclosures, pre-approval, credits, closings, funding wires, conditions, credit ledger; hand the 105.10 fee to Desmond (debit_card); read lock, request log, lock pricing, appraisal order and charges; issue revised Loan Estimate 3 (rate_lock_extension, 2026-10-13, 2703.00); assess the 150.00 zero-tolerance cure (baseline initial Loan Estimate, measured new Loan Estimate, credit_at_closing); issue the Closing Disclosure dated 2026-10-16 with lender credits 2525.10.

ROUND 3: (N-1) the revised Loan Estimate's application fee line and the cure's fee add-back now detect a collection by its ledger entry, whatever its amount, so a 0.00 collection (booked when a charging program's discounts bring the fee to zero) is treated as a collection by rule and compute alike: fee line -P, add-back +P; the add-back's first tier also covers a collection equal to the program fee (adds back nothing), the one branch that had no rule tier. (Class sweep) the fee's credit report offset takes off the booked amount of recent charges whatever it is, so a 0.00 repull charge no longer slips into the per-borrower tier; the returning-borrower tiers of the fee and of the Closing Disclosure no longer say 'only' funded closing. No scored value of this task changed (105.10 / 2703.00 / 150.00 / 2525.10; issued_date 2026-10-16).

ROUND 4: (O-9) both returning-borrower ladders now read the date of the most recent funding wire Larkspur sent on any closing of the customer (XLATEST over funding_wires) instead of the first funded closing record, so several funded closings can no longer split rule and compute; the seed adds the 2019 closing's funding wire (3c0f7e7a-95f0-43bd-8845-448315dcd62a, 212000.00) and gold reads it (find_funding_wires, step 8), shifting the four write steps to 12/19/21/23. (Class sweep) the revised Loan Estimate's extension, surcharge and rush lines and the cure's extension and rush re-baselining now key their tiers on the presence of the entries the rule names (counts), not on amounts above zero; the cure states that no cure entry is booked when it works out to nothing; the cure's three overwrite replacements now name their scope and carry the still-in-force parts (10 percent bucket, post-consummation violations, the timely-revised-LE baseline for every other comparison); the Closing Disclosure tool accepts 0.00 lender credits. No scored value changed (105.10 / 2703.00 / 150.00 / 2026-10-16 / 2525.10).

ROUND 5: (render O-9 class) every cross-category record the rules name is now the record the compute reads: the pre-approval the file was converted from (by the file's preapproval_id), the Hometown Heroes Credit reserved against the file, the file's standard appraisal order (and its own fee charges), the file's rate lock in locked status, the file's closing in scheduled status; the Closing Disclosure's credit line adds the standing balance of the customer's credits from the credit ledger (award and payout entries less applied, reduced, forfeited) instead of one credit's balance. Lock extension lines read any rate lock of the customer, as stated. No scored value changed.

ROUND 6: (N-5 class) every record read is now the one record the rule names, proved by decoy probes on scratch copies of this world (each decoy stored first): an expired firefighter Hometown Heroes Credit (fee 105.10, revised LE 2703.00, cure 150.00, CD 2525.10 unchanged), a second pre-approval not on the file, a cancelled appraisal order carrying its own surcharge, a same-date lower-sequence Loan Estimate, a cancelled lock at -1.000, a cancelled RON closing, an older funding wire; and a reserved-credit world (no award; Heroes and First Home reserved, an expired grant) giving the summed estimate 1000.00 + 2500.00 as the rule now states. Reads: Heroes credit filtered to verified status; the standard appraisal order is the file's non-cancelled one; the latest Loan Estimate is the one with the highest sequence; the reserved estimate adds up every program reserved against the file. No scored value changed.

ROUND 7: (N-6 class) every read now has a stated, computed outcome when its record is absent — no live primary appraisal order (revised LE: no appraisal fee, surcharge or rush; cure: no rush taken out), a transferred-in order read as the primary order, no pre-approval, no Heroes credit, no funding wire, no e-sign intent, no credit report charge, no lock entries, no initial Loan Estimate (0.00), no locked lock, no scheduled closing, no closing date, no credits — each probed on a scratch copy of this world (worklog, Round 7 table). No scored value changed.

ROUND 8: the revised Loan Estimate's extension line and the cure's extension re-baselining now net any lock cost waivers Larkspur booked on the customer's locks in the same one-month period, never below zero (probes: full waiver -> revised LE 2335.00 / cure 518.00; 100.00 waiver -> 2603.00 / 250.00; this world books no waiver, so 368.00 stands); the Closing Disclosure rule now says the short-notice and returning-borrower credits are counted from the day the Closing Disclosure is prepared, not from the later date it carries; the cure's standard-order binding moved into the rush factor that alone reads it (in the revised Loan Estimate it stays outside the factors because the fee sheet itself reads it for the base fee). No scored value changed.

VERIFICATION: check_compute.py --task 1 recomputes each computation on its handling-time world, every factor baseline and whole baseline, and each value_input edge with the depended-on write skipped; the transitive and wrong-order figures above come from the same evaluator applied to the replayed worlds.
user_scenario: You are Desmond Mahler, 41, an emergency-room nurse in Worthington, Ohio, buying 3756 Linworth Meadow Lane on your own with a Larkspur Home Lending loan. You are friendly and a bit wry, you are calling on a break between shifts, and you want things done in one call. You start by saying that your closing used to be October 16th, that on Tuesday you asked your loan officer to push it to Thursday, October 22nd so it would not land on a run of night shifts, and that you still have not received a Closing Disclosure. You want Larkspur to issue your Closing Disclosure for the October 22nd closing today, and the agent has your go-ahead to prepare and send it. You do not ask about any particular fee or credit and you have no idea what the number on it should be. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give your phone number 6145553627 and then the last four of your Social Security number, 5293; if they need something more you give your date of birth, November 2, 1984, or your ZIP code 43085. If the agent asks which day you asked to move the closing, you say it was Tuesday, October 13th, 2026, when you called your loan officer and asked to extend the rate lock for the new date. If the agent tells you there is something you need to pay yourself before the Closing Disclosure can go out, you say 'sure, what is the amount?' and, once the agent hands that step to you, you run it yourself with the details the agent gives, paying with your Visa debit card, and you read back the confirmation you get. You accept whatever amount the agent tells you; you do not try to calculate it. If the agent mentions that an updated Loan Estimate or some other paperwork will also show up in your e-sign portal, you say that is fine. Once the agent tells you the Closing Disclosure has been prepared and will be in your e-sign portal (whether today or on the next business day), you thank them, say tomorrow morning works fine, joke that you will read it before your next shift, and say goodbye.
